task.name: permuted_keyed_memory_with_registry
task.slot_permutation: Every frame independently places stable identities and readout in random slots; padding identity is -1.
task.targets: Single-link routes 0.60 times the queried value. Two-link adds 0.35 times the cyclic successor value.
task.data_separation: Fresh seeds and sample RNG streams not used by v5; threshold selection uses validation only; test results are emitted once after training and selection.

model.candidate_set: All present memory identities to the current readout identity.

training.topology_gradient: Soft task-loss training first, then straight-through hard-action task-loss fine-tuning; no edge/action training labels.

validation_selection.rule: Maximize weighted mean of edge F1 and macro recall for operation classes present in validation; tie-break by lower validation MSE, then higher confidence threshold.

evolution.topology_policy: Carry hard topology between frames; remap each frame by persisted neuron ID; evaluate transition operations against the current frame target.

decision_rules.quality_ci: Paired per-seed relative MSE delta; 95% two-sided t interval upper bound must be below zero.
decision_rules.interpretation: Fixed before the new test set is evaluated. Validation may select only the action confidence threshold.

controls.parameter_matched: Stable-identity-canonicalized flat MLP with nearest integer hidden width to graph parameter count.
controls.linear_mac_matched: Stable-identity-canonicalized flat MLP with nearest integer hidden width to graph Linear MAC count.
controls.linear_mac_contract: Counts Linear output elements times input width, batch size one. Multiply-add FLOPs subtotal is 2x this count; scatter, reductions, pointwise operations, activations, optimizer, memory traffic and backend fusion are excluded.
controls.identity_canonicalization: Decode task key bits and scatter valid neurons into canonical identity slots; registry IDs remain separate from input feature identity.

cost_accounting.flops_scope: Report exact Linear MAC subtotal and 2x multiply-add subtotal. Do not claim total FLOPs: installed PyTorch MPS build exposes CPU profiler activity only, while sparse index_add/scatter, nonlinear and optimizer operations are not covered by the Linear subtotal.

limitations: Synthetic key-value retrieval does not establish language or broad capability claims.
Pool sizes are tested through 64 memory neurons; this does not establish asymptotic scaling.
Identity registry persistence is a local atomic JSON file contract; concurrent writers and remote storage are outside this run.
Host and MPS memory measurements are sampled every 2 ms and may miss transient peaks.
Total MPS FLOPs are not exactly available in this PyTorch build; Linear MAC and multiply-add subtotals are reported separately.
